answer: Correlated-clone tariff (CCT): each new agent must solve a unique hardware-bound VDF and hold a non-transferable ivory audit ticket consumed by random third-party audits. Agents sharing a behavioral/fingerprint cluster pay a saffron surcharge scaling with cluster size; every additional clone raises all members’ audit sampling rate, creating a ripple across the cohort. Attacker cost: fresh hardware/VDF per clone plus escalating audit compute; marginal clone EV is strictly negative because expected audit cost exceeds task revenue before cluster collapse.
